tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i zhal gsung blo sbyong don bdun ma'i bka' khrid bzhugs/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la/ mdo dang / gzhung dang / man ngag bcas gsum yod pa las 'di man ngag yin/ spyir theg pa chen po'i lam rim la gzhung nas bshad pa'i lam rim dang / man ngag nas bshad pa'i lam rim gnyis las 'di man ngag yin/ lam rim zhes pa theg pa chen po'i lam nyams su len pa'i rim pa yin/ bod la grags che ba'i blo sbyong ni zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa dang / blo sbyong don bdun ma 'di gnyis yin/ don bdun ma ni jo bo rje las byung ba yin/ khong la spyir bla ma bdun cu don gnyis yod cing de'i nang nas blo sbyong gi khrid bla ma gser gling pa las zhus pa red/ blo sbyong 'di la lus lta bu dang / yan lag lta bu gnyis yod pa las 'di lus lta bu yin/ rtsa tshig 'di dang po jo bo rjes gsungs pa dang / de yang don tshan bdun du bsdus nas gsungs pa red/ don tshan dang po sngon 'gro rten gyi chos ni/ dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /ces pa 'dis bstan pa red/ dang po zhes pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab dgos gsungs pa red/ sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam pa bzhi zhes dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom dgos kyi red/ theg pa chen po'i lam nyams su len pa la sngon du nges 'byung gi blo skye dgos pas/ de skye ba'i phyir du 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la sogs pa bsgom dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ dag la zhes pa/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa de yang bslab dgos gsungs pa yin pa 'dra/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pas nges 'byung skyes pa'i rjes su/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blang ba la sogs byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/

don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang / kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gnyis yod/ de las dang po don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la mnyam bzhag dang / rjes thob gnyis yod/ dang po mnyam bzhag gi sngon 'gro la/ rtog la dbugs ni bgrang bar bya/ /zhes pas rtog ces pa/ rnam rtog rags pa zhi ba'i thabs la dbugs bgrang dgos zhes pa red/ dbugs phar 'gro ba dang tshur yong ba nang du bsdad pa gsum gcig tu rtsis pa'i grangs 21 tsam bgrang dgos zhes pa red/ des rnam rtog rags pa zhi 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'di sngags kyi khrid yig du ma las gsungs yod/ ka ma la shī la'i sgom rim nang du yang dbugs de gnad che ba'i skor mang po gsungs yod/ dngos gzhi la/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ /gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang du bzhag /ces phyi rol du snang ba'i chos thams cad sems las tha dad med pa rmi lam lta bu sems kyi snang ba yin bsam dgos/ rmi lam mang po rmis na yang / so so'i sems kyi snang ba ma yin pa sems las tha dad du yod pa ma red/ de bzhin du phyi rol du snang ba'i chos gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs chos thams cad sems las tha dad du med bsam/ de ltar byas na snang ba'i yul med par mthong ngo / 'o na sems de ga 'dra zhig red zer na/ ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ /ces sems de gdod ma nas skye ma myong bas ma skyes pa dang / ma skyes pa yin tsang / 'gag ma myong ba dang / gnas ma myong ba zhig dang / de lta bu'i rig pa'am sems de ma skyes ma 'gag stong pa nyid yin pa de la dpyad pa gtong dgos zhes pa red/ de ltar dpyad pas sems kyi gshis ma grub pas 'dzin pa'i sems ma grub par mthong / dpyad ces pa pha rol phyin pa'i lta ba bsgom pa'i skabs su mtha' gcig tu dpyad pa gtong dgos kyi red/

dbu ma'i rigs pa'i sgo nas dpyad pa btang nas lta ba rnyed pa'i thabs byed pa sogs kyis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ga 'dra zhig red 'dug ha go ba de la lta ba zer/ lta ba de shes pa de ni ma bcos pa bsgom par byed pa'i thabs yin pas des na nges par dpyad dgos/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba bsgom par byed pa'i thabs ma 'dra ba yod pas mtha' gcig tu dpyad pa gtong dgos pa'i nges pa med/ dge lugs pa ltar na gsang sngags kyi skabs su yang mtha' gcig tu rigs pas dpyad dgos gsungs kyi red/ gzhan rnams kyis gsang sngags pa la thabs gzhan yod/ nges par mtha' gcig tu dpyad dgos pa'i khyab pa med gsungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba la mtha' gcig tu rigs pas dpyad dgos/ dpyad nas lta ba la nges shes brnyed na/ lta ba bsgom stangs de yul cir yang ma grub par blos gang du'ang mi 'dzin pa zhes/ sems ma bcos par bzhag pa de red/ des na ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad ces pa red/ gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /zhes pa/ gnyen po ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid yin bsam pa'i blo de la zer/ spang bya bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen po yin pas de ltar dang / nyid ces pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid yin bsam pa'i blo de nyid rang sar te/ rang sdod pa'i sa cha stong pa nyid de la zer ba red/ dper na stong pa nyid yin bsam pa'i gnas lugs la dpyod pa'i shes rab de nyid kyang stong pa nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la grol dgos zhes pa red/ 'o na lta ba de ga 'dra zhig bsgom dgos zhe na/ lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang du bzhag ces/ ngo bo zhes pa dang gnas lugs rang bzhin rnams gcig pa red/ des na kun gzhi zhes sems kyi gsal cha tsam la go dgos/ spyir sems dang sems byung zhes gnyis yod/ sems de la 'dzin stangs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod/ khyad par du gtso sems zhes don gyi ngo bo mthong mkhan de ma 'dra ba zhig yod pas de las kun gzhi zhes pa de sems gsal tsam de la ngos 'dzin dgos/

yul la 'phro la khad/ sems gsal tsam de la kun gzhi dang / kun gzhi'i ngo bo spros pa thams cad las 'das pa yin pa de'i ngang du bzhag dgos gsungs pa red/ sa skya/ bka' brgyud/ rnying ma thams cad kyi lta ba sgom stangs de gcig pa red/ yul mtha' bzhi gang du'ang / de blos gang du'ang ma 'dzin par/ bcas bcos dgag sgrub ma bgyid par rang babs su bzhag dgos zhes pa red/ des mnyam bzhag grub pa red/ don dam byang chub sems kyi mnyam gzhag grub nas/ thun mtshams kyi nyams len la/ sems la gang snang ba rang dang gzhan thams cad sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya dgos zhes pa la/ thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya/ zhes sems can gang dang gang snang ba rang dang gzhan thams cad sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya dgos zhes sgyu mas sprul pa'i skyes bu/ snang la mi bden pa de ltar byas na mnyam bzhag rtogs pa'i bogs 'don 'dra yong gi yod pa 'dra/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la/ dang po byams pa legs par bsgom/ zhes pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i dang po/ byams pa dang snying rje gnyis 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ bka' gdams pa'i lugs ltar na rgyu 'bras don bdun kyi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i lam bsgom gyi yod pa red/ sems can thams cad ma yin par bsam/ drin chen po yin/ ma yin pas bka' drin 'khor thabs med par bsam/ drin lan zhig sprad dgos pas drin lan 'jal 'dod bcas yang nas yang du bsgom/ de nas byams pa bsgom/ byams pa zhes pa/ sems can thams cad la bde ba dang / bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bsam/ gnas skabs mtho ris kyi bde ba dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par bsam/ gnad che shos sangs rgyas thob par bsam pa de yin pas de yang nas yang du bsgom/ tshig tsam gyi sgo nas kyang bsgom pa dang / rtag par bsgom ci thub bya/ dper na/

sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog ces pa dang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la ngas 'god par bya bsam pa de la byams pa zhes bya/ snying rje zhes pa sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bcas pa bral bar bsam pa dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba las ngas bsgral/ grol bar gyur cig sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba yin pa de dang bral bar gyur cig bsam pa de yang nas yang du bsgom pa de la zer/ byams pa dang snying rje 'di dag bsgom par byed pa la/ nges 'byung de yag po bsgom dgos/ des na dang po sngon 'gro dag la slob/ zhes pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs bsgom zhes pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs de legs par ma shes na/ byams pa dang / snying rje legs po mi skyes/ de med na sems bskyed yong thabs med/ des na sngon ma sngon ma rnams gnad che bar shes te legs por bsgom dgos kyi red/ byams pa dang / snying rje gnyis gtan nas 'bral mi rung / gal te bral na bcas par gyur pa de las nyams tshar ba red/ dngos gzhi la/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyangs/ zhes pa jo bo rjes blo sbyong 'ga' shas kyi nang du/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba gnyis ka bstan yod/ gser gling pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag de la bdag gzhan brje ba rang bsgom dgos kyi 'dug dang po nyid nas bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa las bdag gzhan mnyam pa la sogs ma gnang ba red/ de la gtong zhes pa rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba dang bcas pa thams cad sbyin nas/ des sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas thob pa'i cha rkyen gyur par bsam/ len zhes pas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gnyis rang gis blangs nas/ sems can thams cad la sdug kun gnyis med par gyur bsam pa'i sgo nas/ gnyis po spel mar sbyangs zhes gtong len gnyis res mos nyams su len dgos gsungs pa red/ de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/

/zhes pa ni de gnyis mtshams mtshams su rlung la bskyon zhes rlung gi rta la bskyon nas bsgom zhes pa red/ rlung sna bug nas nang du yong ba'i skabs su/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad kha dog nag po'i rnam par rang gi snying khar thim par bsam/ rlung sna sgo nas phyir 'gro ba'i skabs su/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam pas sems can thams cad la phog pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i cha rkyen thams cad 'grigs par gyur song bsam nas bsgom dgos/ thun mtshams su/ yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /de la dran pa bskul ba'i phyir/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyangs/ /len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsam/ /zhes pas skabs su yul gsum zhes pa/ yul mdzes pa/ mi mdzes pa dang / bar ma gsum la brten nas nyon mongs pa dug gsum skye yi yod pa red/ de yang yul gsum la brten nas nyon mongs pa dug gsum skye ba de dag dge rtsa gsum la bsgyur dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ dper na/ yul mdzes pa la brten nas 'dod chags skyes byung na/ 'dod chags de lam du len dgos kyi red/ sems can gzhan nga dang 'dra ba 'dod chags skyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags de nga'i steng du smin par shog cig /sems can thams cad 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa dang / de bzhin du sems can thams cad zhe sdang med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa dang / sems can thams cad gti mug med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pas 'dun pa bsgyur nas dug gsum po de dge rtsa gsum la bsgyur dgos gsungs pa bcas/ don du gzhan gyi nyon mongs rang thog tu len dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ nyon mongs skyes pa'i tshe phar phyin theg pa la nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs mang po yod/ dper na lta ba bsgom pas nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs dang /

blo sbyong gi sgo nas spang ba'i thabs 'di lta bu dang / zhe sdang skyes na thabs shes gzhan gyis ma thub na/ blo sbyong bsgom pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang rang la smin par shog snyam pa dang / de rnams zhe sdang med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par gyur cig snyam dgos/ de la dran pa bskul ba'i phyir/ spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyangs/ zhes byang chub sems de rang la dran pa bskul ba'i phyir spyod lam kun tu tshig gi sgo nas sbyangs dgos zhes pa de la gnad chen po yod/ yi dam bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su yang 'di ltar dgos/ dper na spyan dbu ma/ dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba sogs tshig gi sgo nas lab dgos gsungs yod/ de bzhin 'dir yang tshig gi sgo nas sbyangs na blo sbyong bar phan gyi yod gsungs pa red/ sngon gyi dus su rgya gar lho phyogs su nang pa gcig gis bden pa bzhi tshig gi sgo nas sgom gyi yod pa'i gtam rgyud 'dug /dper na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa la sogs pa brjod nas bsgom dgos kyi yod pa dang / de bzhin 'dir blo sbyong skabs su yang tshig gi sgo nas sbyangs na phan thogs chen po yod gsungs pa'i don red/ mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bde bas ma rnams bde gyur cig /zhes pa 'di ni klu sgrub kyi smon lam rin chen phreng ba las byung ba yin/ tshig 'di tshar gcig kha ton byas pa la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ 'di phan yon chen po yod pa'i stabs kyis tshad med bzhi de kha ton byed pa dang / tshad med bzhi de bsgom thub na de ltar bsgom dgos kyi yod red/ de ltar mi thub pa'i dbang gis/ nga tshos sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshig gi sgo nas brjod kyi yod pa red/ sngon gyi dus su bka' gdams pa gcig gis mi rtag pa bsgom pa la/

rang nyid nam 'chi nges pa med pas tshe 'di'i bya ba la dgos pa med par dgongs nas/ phreng ba bzung nas/ dgos pa med ces mang po skyor gyi yod pa'i lo rgyus 'dug len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsams/ /zhes gtong len gnyis kyi nang nas len pa/ sdig pa dang sdug bsngal gnyis len pa'i go rim dang po rang nas brtsams dgos/ dper na rang la na tsha dang sdug bsngal skyes byung na/ rang la ma 'ongs par/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ phyi mar dmyal ba skye ba la sogs pa dang / de'i rgyu bsags pa sogs sdug bsngal mang po yong rgyu yod pa de thams cad skad cig da lta nyid du sdug bsngal 'di'i steng du len par shog bsams nas/ dang po rang nas len/ de 'dra byed thub pa byung na de rjes gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung len par sems sbyangs/ de ltar byung na byang chub kyi sems gnyis legs par sbyangs thub gsungs pa red/ blo sbyong gi dngos gzhi 'di yan chod yin/ 'di ni theg pa chen po'i nyams len mthar thug pa red/ de'i yan la med pa'i nyams len yin gsungs yod pa red/ jo bo rjes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug nang du gsungs pa'i gzhung don ltar rgya cher gsungs yod/ spyod 'jug nyams su len pa la blo sbyong med na med thabs med gsungs pa red/ nyams len byed mkhan rnams la nyams len mthar thug de 'di red/ 'dis sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis bcas don tshan gnyis grub pa red/ da ni de'i yan lag lta bu lnga yod/ dang po rkyen ngan byang chub lam tu bsgyur ba la/ /snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan byang chub lam la bsgyur/ /zhes pas rang gis sngon byas pa'i sdig pa'i 'bras bu'i dbang gis sa gzhi khang khyim la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba zhig med pa dang / bcud kyi sems can rnams kyis rang la gnod 'tshe byed pa sogs de rnams sngon sdig pa bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin pas/

snod bcud gnyis nyams pa shin tu rgud pa'i rkyen ngan pa zhes chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen red/ de 'gal rkyen du ma song bar byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rang la phyi snod dang nang bcud kyi sems can gyi gnod pa lta bu'i 'gal rkyen de dag lam du bsgyur thabs ga 'dra zhig byed dgos zhe na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang / sbyor ba khyad par can gyis lam la bsgyur ba bcas gsum gyi sgo nas bsgom dgos pa las/ dang po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ le lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ /zhes pas le lan zhes lan pa thams cad mang po la ded rgyu yod ma red/ gcig la ded dgos red gsungs pa red/ de ga re la ded dgos zhe na/ bdag gces 'dzin la ded dgos gsungs pa red/ rang la gnas tshul sdug bsngal byung ba de/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la brten nas byung na 'dra/ nang sems can gyi na tsha la sogs pa sdug bsngal ga 'dra zhig byung ba yin pa de dag gzhan gyis byas pa ma red/ skyon de thams cad bdag gces 'dzin la brten nas byung ba red gsungs pa red/ nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus 'jig tshogs la/ /lta las byung ba blo yis mthong gyur nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs pa dang skyon nam sdug bsngal byung ba de 'jig lta bdag 'dzin las byung ba red/ de bas na le lan thams cad rang la bda' gang thub byed dgos gsungs pa red/ spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod pa rnams/ de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen 'di kos bdag la ci zhig bya/ zhes dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ /bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang / /de gnyis dang ni yongs 'brel bas/ /nyes pa du ma skye bar 'gyur/ ces gsungs pa ltar le lan thams cad gcig la bda' dgos/

rang la mi 'dod pa yong ba de mi gzhan gyis byas song bsam pa gcig yod de don du bdag 'dzin gyi skyon red/ dper na/ sangs rgyas la sdug bsngal bye bas gtses na yang sangs rgyas la skyon spu tsam byed thub pa rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ de bdag 'dzin med pa'i stobs kyis red/ de bas na bdag 'dzin spong ci thub bya dgos gsungs pa red/ kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /zhes pas sems can rnams la bka' drin che bar bsgom dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ da lta sems can gyi dus su sems can thams cad pha ma ma byas pa yod pa ma red/ de thams cad bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa sha stag red/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub dgos pa de ni sems can la ma brten par sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs yod pa ma red/ des na bde skyid thams cad sems can la brten nas byung ba yin pas bka' drin che bar bsgom dgos gsungs pa red/ don du dang po bdag 'dzin ha go dgos kyi red/ bdag 'dzin zhes pa de/ nga rang gces po byed rgyu de red/ nga rang gces po zhes pa ni/ gnad chen po byed pa/ dper na rgyal kha nga rang gis thob dgos/ go sa mtho shos de ngas byed dgos/ yag shos de nga la yong dgos bsam pa de la bdag 'dzin zer gyi red/ skyon thams cad des byas pa red/ so so la nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / las mi dge ba bsags pa de thams cad bsam blo btang na bdag 'dzin de las byung ba yin par ha go thub pa byed dgos/ don dam sems bskyed la brten pa ni/ 'khrul snang sku bzhir bsgom pa yis/ /stong nyid srung ba bla na med/ /ces blo 'khrul ba'i ngo la 'dzin pa yong ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sku bzhi yin bsam pas bltas na de la stong nyid kyis bsrung yong / stong pa nyid kyis bsrung ba de srung ba'i thabs bla na med pa zhig red ces gsungs pa de stong pa nyid kyis bsrung ba de bar chad de las skyobs pa'i srung ba yag shos yin gsungs pa red/

'khrul ba'i snang ba la spyir mang po yod kyang de'i nang nas bar chad de la blta dgos/ stong pa nyid la blta ba ni sku bzhi'i ngo bo la blta ba red/ skye ba med pa de chos sku dang / 'gag pa med pa de longs sku/ gnas pa med pa de sprul sku/ de gsum dbyer mi phyed pa de ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru blta dgos/ rkyen ngan gyi ngo bo de sku bzhi'i ngo bo khyad med pa blta dgos kyi red/ don du stong pa nyid kyi ngang du 'jog dgos zhes pa yin/ sku bzhi'i gnas lugs yin gsungs pa las sku bzhi+i ngo ma yin gsungs pa ma red/ gsang sngags kyi gnas skabs nas 'khrul snang sku bzhi yin zhes 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi khrid du gsungs kyi yod kyang 'dir de 'dra rang gsung gi ma red/ de bas na mdor na stong pa nyid bsgom pa de bar chad bsrung ba'i thabs yag po red gsungs pa red/ 'gal rkyen ga 'dra zhig byung na yang stong pa nyid yin bsam na stong pa nyid de'i ngo bo sangs rgyas kyis yag tu gtong mi dgos/ sems can gyis ngan du gtong mi dgos pas gcig pa yin bsam pa dang / gzhan yang snang ba sems yin bsam na bar chad kyis tshugs kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ gsum pa sbyor ba khyad par can gyis rkyen ngan lam tu bsgyur ba ni/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /zhes chos bsgrub skabs 'gal rkyen mang po yong gi red/ de bzlog pa'i thabs gegs sel bshad pa red/ de la tshogs bsags pa/ sdig pa bshags pa/ gnod byed la gtor ma gtong ba/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba bzhi red/ gnod byed la gtor ma gtong zhes pa/ rang la na tsha dang 'dres gnod pa sogs byung na/ de la gtor ma gtong / blo sbyong yag po bsgom mkhan zhig yin na/ khyed rang gis nga la bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i grogs byas pa de la ngas thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ da dung khyed rang gis nga la grogs gang thub gyis zhes lab nas gtor ma gtong /

de tsam bsgom mi thub mkhan yin na da ngas chos bsgrub pa la bar chad ma byed/ khyed rang gtor mas tshims par byas te sa gzhan du 'gro bar gyis zhes gtor ma gtong dgos/ de nas chos skyong la 'phrin las bcol ba yin zhus nas gtor ma 'bul dgos/ de lta bu'i nyams len de sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog zhes pa de yin/ 'phral la gang thub sgom tu sbyar/ 'phral la zhes pa glo bur du gang byung ba de bsgom dgos/ dper na/ rang la sdug po byung na rkyen ngan sdug po des sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal de rnams sdug po de'i thog tu len thub par bsgom/ de bzhin du rang la skyid po zhig byung na/ sems can thams cad la skyid po thob par shog ces bsgom dgos pa'i don red/ bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa la/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa theg pa chen po nyams su len pa'i man ngag gi snying po mdor bsdu na stobs lnga'i khongs su 'du/ dang po 'phen pa'i stobs ni/ ngas nyi ma de ring nas brtsams te sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom gyi yin bsam pa zhig byas/ bka' gdams pa rnams kyis gsung sgros la/ ngas ma 'ongs pa la yag po zhig dang / legs po zhig byed dgos bsam pa'i dam bca' byed dgos gsungs pa bzhin byed pa de la 'phen pa'i stobs zer/ yang yang goms pa'i stobs ni/ blo sbyong 'di yang nas yang du goms tu bcug pa de la zer/ dkar po sa bon gyi stobs ni/ mchod pa phul ba dang / bsod nams bsags pa sogs blo sbyong legs por yong bar shog ces smon lam 'debs pa sogs la brtson pa de yin/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ bdag gces 'dzin de'i nyes dmigs mang po bsam/ des bdag thog ma med pa nas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor tu bcug tshe 'di la chos bsgrub tu mi bcug mkhan de yang bdag gces 'dzin de red/

chos bsgrub na yang / chos la skyon dang / bar chad byed mkhan yang bdag gces 'dzin yin pas/ des na dgra bo'i nang gi dgra chen de bdag gces 'dzin yin bsam/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi dbang du gcig lus song na/ bdag ni bsregs te bsad gyur tam/ bdag gi mgo bo bcad kyang sla'i/ /rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs pa'i/ /dgra la 'dud par mi bya'o/ /zhes pa bzhin rtsa ba nas mi gtong bsam pa'i dam bca' byed/ smon lam gyi bar stobs lnga yi nyams len gtso bo byed dgos kyi red/ 'chi kha ma'i nyams len la/ theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ /stobs lnga nyid yin spyod lam gces/ zhes spyir 'pho ba'i gdams ngag mang du gsungs kyang / theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ sangs rgyas dran nas shi ba de phan yon chen po yin pas 'di lta bu nyams su len dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ spyod lam gces/ ces pa gnad chen po red ces gsungs pa red/ rab skyil krung dang rnam snang chos bdun gyi ngang du 'chi thub na legs shos red/ de min na/ sangs rgyas gzim stangs byas nas nyal ba'i ngang du 'chi thub na legs/ lnga pa blo 'byongs ba'i tshad ni/ chos rnams dgos pa gcig tu 'du/ /dpang po gnyis kyis gtso bor gzung / yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /zhes chos rnams zhes pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos rnams dgos pa gcig tu 'du zhes gcig rang red gsungs pa red/ dgos pa gcig de ni bdag 'dzin 'dul ba la gsungs pa red/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa'i chos de la theg pa che chung gnyis yod/ bdag gces 'dzin 'dul ba la theg pa dman pa'i chos/ gzhan gces par 'dzin pa la theg pa chen po'i chos zhes bya/ de bas na theg pa che chung gnyis kas bdag gces 'dzin de 'dul dgos par gcig pas chos rnams dgos pa gcig tu 'du zhes gsungs pa red/

nyams len byed skabs nyams su len thub par 'dug gam mi 'dug ga 'dra byas nas tshod lta byed dgos zhe na/ bdag gces 'dzin de chung du 'gro gi 'dug na chos de nyams len byung ba red/ bdag gces 'dzin de chung du ma song / de'i kha snon 'dra por song ba yin na/ chos de don med la phyin pa red/ dper na/ mkhas pas kyang nga mkhas pa yin bsam pa'i nga rgyal byung na de chos kyi skyon byas pa red/ nyams len byed skabs su/ nga sgom chen yin/ nga las lhag pa sgom chen med bsam pa sogs byung tshe chos de don med song ba red gsungs pa red/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo gzung / zhes pa dpang po la gnyis yod/ gcig ni mi gzhan dag gis dpang po byed pa dang / gcig ni rang gi sems kyis dpang po byed pa gnyis yod pa de las gzhan dag de dpang po yin kyang / gtso bo rang gi sems de red/ mi gzhan rnams kyis rang gi chos legs nyes shes thub kyi ma red/ chos zer ba de lus ngag gnyis gcig pu'i steng du ma yin par gtso bo rang gi sems kyis dpyad pa gtong dgos kyi red ces 'grel ba 'ga' shas las 'di ltar gsungs yod/ da ni shi nas dmyal bar skye na yang ngas byed rgyu de las lhag pa zhig rtsa ba nas med bsam pa zhig byung na so sos gdeng 'khel ba zhig byung ba red/ de ltar byung na chos pa rnam dag yag po zhig byung ba red/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ ces rtag par sems bde po byed dgos kyi red/ sems ma bde ba byed rgyu yod ma red/ rkyen ngan 'dra po ga re byung na yang blo sbyong gi thog nas nyams su len thub bsam nas yid bde bya dgos gsungs pa red/ spyir btang theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'gal zla che shos ni zhe sdang red/ dang po rgyu mtshan chung ngu 'ga' zhig la brten nas yid mi bde ba 'byung gi yod pa red/ des na khong khro bkag dgos na/ dang po yid mi bde ba de bkag dgos kyi red/

spyod 'jug las/ ci la babs kyang bdag gis ni/ /dga' ba'i yid ni dkrugs mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ bka' gdams pa'i gsung zhig gi nang la/ dge bshes de la na tsha yod red zer lab na/ de skyon yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang dge bshes de thugs bde po mi 'dug zer na de ni nyams len med pa'i rtags red gsungs pa red/ de bas na blo bde po byed rgyu de gal chen po yin/ bde ba byung na yang bde po byas/ sdug bsngal byung na yang bde po byas/ bstod pa byung na yang bde po byas/ smad pa byung na'ang bde po byas/ de ltar blo bde po byung na blo 'byongs thub pa red/ yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /zhes dran shes mi bsten pa'i skabs dang / chos la bsam blo mi gtong ba'i skabs dang / de bzhin gzab gzab mi byed pa'i skabs su nyon mongs pa byung ba de dag blo sbyong gis khegs thub kyi yod na blo 'byongs pa'i tshad yin/ drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig ni/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab/ /ces pa ni don tshan gsum la bslab dgos zhes pa dang / blo sbyong gi khas blangs dang mi 'gal ba zhes so sos ga re khas blangs pa de dang 'gal ba byed rgyu yod pa ma red zhes pa'i don red/ bka' gdams pa mang po'i gsung rgyun la chos gcig gis gcig la khyad ma bsad pa zhig dgos kyi red ces gsungs pa red/ dper na nga mkhas pa yin bsam nas tshul khrims bsrung mi dgos pa dang / nyams len mi byed pa 'dra po red/ nyams len byed mkhan zhig yin na slob sbyong mi byed pa de 'dra byed rgyu med/ sgom rgyab mkhan rnams kyis kha 'don mi byed pa dang / kha 'don byed mkhan rnams kyis bsgom mi rgyag pa de 'dra byed rgyu yod ma red/ des na blo sbyong sgom mkhan yin bsam nas rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam tshig de dag las ma nyams pa zhig byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ blo sbyong tho cor ma song ba zhes/

nga blo sbyong sgom mkhan yin bsam nas 'dre gnas pa'i sa cha la 'gro ba dang / 'go ba'i nad yod pa'i mi dang mnyam du 'gro ba sogs byed rgyu med gsungs pa red/ gang ltar mi gzhan pas 'di blo sbyong sgom mkhan yin sa red bsam pa sogs mi mngon pa zhig dgos gsungs pa red/ blo sbyong phyogs ris su ma shor ba zhes/ blo sbyong phyogs re zung la bsgom thub pa dang / 'ga' shas la bsgom mi thub pa ma byas par thams cad la bsgom gang thub tu bya dgos gsungs pa red/ dper na rang la dga' po yod pa de tshos gnod pa byas na bzod thub pa dang / dgra bos gnod pa byas pa la bzod pa bsgom mi thub pa dang / yang sems can gyis gnod pa byas pa bzod thub pa dang / na tsha byung na bzod sgom mi thub pa de 'dra byung na phyogs re ba zer/ de ltar ma yin par phyogs thams cad nas bsgom gang thub bya dgos gsungs pa red/ 'dun pa bsgyur la rang sar bzhag zhes pa 'dun pa ni 'du shes red/ 'du shes de bsgyur dgos pa red/ spyod lam de snga ma ltar rang sar 'jog dgos kyi red gsungs/ dper na dang po nyams len byed pa'i dus su sems kyi steng nas yag po ma byas pa lus ngag gnyis nas rnam 'gyur bstan rgyu yod ma red gsungs pa red/ des na sems kyi steng nas blo sbyong de yag po zhig bsgom/ lus ngag gnyis snga ma ltar gnas dgos kyi red/ yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ zhes pa ni rkang pa dang lag pa med pa lta bu mi gzhan gyi skyon brjod pa dang / de ga nang bzhin tshul khrims 'chal ba sogs gzhan gyi skyon rnams brjod par mi bya zhes pa'i don red/ gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /zhes pa ni spyir btang sems can thams cad tha na dud 'gro yin yang skyon gyi phyogs nam yang bsam par mi bya/ khyad par du chos kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas kyang so so'i mnyam du 'gro sdod byed mkhan rnams kyi skyon gang yang bsam par mi bya gsungs pa red/

gzhan yang gzhan gyi skyon de snang na rang gi blo 'khrul ba'i snang ba red ma gtogs/ gzhan la skyon yod ma red/ snang ba thams cad sems red bsam pa zhig dgos/ spyir gzhan la skyon brjod rgyu dang / rang la bstod pa byed rgyu de chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka la 'gal ba chen po yin pa dpal sprul rin po ches mang po gsungs yod/ de min yang byang chub sems dpa'i pham pa 'byung gzhi bdag bstod gzhan smod las pham pa dang po yong sa de gzhan la skyon sems pa de nas yong gi yod pa red/ des na gzhan gyi skyon brjod rgyu med gsungs pa red/ de ltar gzhan gyi skyon mi bsam pa dang / rang gi yon tan mi bsam rgyu de gnad chen po red/ mdor na gzhan gyi yon tan bsam/ rang gi skyon bsam/ rang gi skyon de spang gang thub byed dgos pas gzhan gyi skyon mi brjod gsungs pa red/ nyon mongs gang che sngon du spang / /zhes rang rgyud la brtag pas spyir nyon mongs thams cad dang / lhag par de'i nang nas che shos de dang po sbyang dgos gsungs pa red/ rang la brtag pas nyon mongs pa rnams kyi nang nas nga rgyal dang ser sna la sogs ga re che 'dug brtag /rang gis ma shes na grogs po rnams la brtag bcug nas gang che ba de sngon nas sbyang dgos zhes pa red/ 'bras bu re ba thams cad spongs/ /zhes pa blo sbyong nyams len byed pa'i skabs su 'bras bu la re ba spo+ong dgos/ dper na blo sbyong byas pas nad gdon zhi ba yong bas de'i ched du dang / gzhan gyis 'di chos pa yag po zhig red zer nas rnyed bkur byed pa la sogs pa yong bsam pa de dag dang / skye ba phyi mar rang dmyal bar mi skye bar phan gyi red bsam pa dang / thar pa thob pa'i thabs yin snyam pa sogs mdor na rang don gyi re ba zhes/ blo sbyong bsgom pas rang don bsgrub dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa mtha' dag gtong dgos gsungs pa red/ dug can gyi zas spangs/

zhes pa zas kyis lus rgyas kyang / zas nang dug yod na gnod 'tshe byed pa ltar/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'bras bu bde ba thob pa'i thabs yin kyang / dngos po la bden par 'dzin na 'khor ba las brgal mi thub/ des na byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa de la bden par ma 'dzin par stong pa nyid bsgom dgos kyi red/ theg pa chen po'i lam bsgom pa de la thabs shes gnyis ka dgos kyi red/ gong du bshad pa de dag thabs yin pas de la lta bas rtsis zin pa zhig dang / kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad la lta bas rtsis zin pa zhig dgos/ stong pa nyid yin bsam pa zhig dang / sgyu ma lta bu yin bsam pa bcas thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bsgom pa'i lta ba de med na/ dug can gyi zas dang 'dra ba red gsungs pa red/ dug can gyi zas zhes pa de zhen pa bzhi la bshad kyi yod pa red/ des na dge ba sna gcig bsags pa yin na yang / de zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba zhig dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ ces dper na mi gshis ka bzang po zhig yin na rang la phan btags pa de ga dus yin kyang mi brjed pa sems la nyar sdod kyi red/ de bzhin du gnod pa byas pa de 'khon du bzung nas ga dus yang ma brjed par sems kyi nang du nyar sdod kyi red/ de lta bu gzhung yun ring du ma bzung zhes pa'i don red/ shags ngan ma dgod/ zhes shags zer na rtsod pa rgyag pa red/ shags ngan pa zhes gzhan gyis rang la mtshang 'bru ba sogs byung ba'i skabs phar phyogs de la gnad ci 'gro'i shags byed pa de la mtshang 'bru ba'am shags ngan zer gyi red/ de 'dra ma byed gsungs pa red/ 'phrang ma sgugs/ zhes pa ni gnod pa byed yag gi go skabs ma sgugs ces pa red/ dper na dgra bo la lan de ma thag tu 'jal ma thub na 'phrang nas bsgug nas 'phrog bcom byed kyi red/ de bzhin rang la blo kha ma babs pa dang gnod pa zhig byung na/

da lta ngas lan 'phrod kyi mi 'dug ste lan sprod thub pa'i dus tshod gcig byung na ngas lan sprad kyi yin bsam pa'i blo yong ba de 'dor dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ phan btags lan du gnod byas na/ /yang lan snying rje chen po bsgom/ /'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog gis/ /nyes pa'i lan la phan par gdams/ ces gsungs pa ltar tshur la gnod pa byas kyang phar la phan ci thogs byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ gnad la mi dbab/ ces gzhan gyi sems la phog po de 'dra ma byed gsungs pa red/ dper na mi mang po 'dzoms sa la/ khyod kyis rku byas pa red ces zer ba lta bu/ khyod tshul khrims nyams pa red zer ba lta bu gzhan gyi sems la 'dzer ba'i tshig mi smra/ gzhan gyi sems bsrung rgyu de chos nyams su len mkhan rnams kyi nyams len gyi gnad shin tu chen po red/ dper na so so'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa 'dul dgos pa de bzhin du gzhan la skad cha bshad stangs tshun chad la do khur chen po byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'gel/ zhes mdzo la bkal rgyu khal chen po de glang lta bu sems can chung chung la mi 'gel zhes/ rang gis nyes pa byas pa'i skyon de gzhan la 'gel mi rung gsungs pa red/ dper na rang gis nyes pa zhig byas pa de mi gzhan gyis byas pa red zer ba de 'dra lab rgyu yod ma red gsungs pa red/ spyod 'jug las/ rang gi nyes pa chung byas kyang / /skye bo mang la rab tu shod/ /gzhan gyi nyes pa chung byas kyang / /rang gi skyon du yin zhes brjod/ /ces gzhan gyis nyes pa gang 'dra zhig byas kyang de ngas byas pa yin ces lab dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ gal te de ltar ma thub na'ang rang gis nyes pa byas pa de gzhan gyis byas pa red lab mi rung gsungs pa red/ lto log mi bya/ zhes dper na mi la na tsha god chags byung na lto bcos byed kyi yod pa red/

de ni tshe 'di'i don gcig pu red/ de 'dra ba blo sbyong 'di yang tshe 'di yi nad gdon zhi ba'i thabs tsam dang / mi gzhan gyis 'di chos pa yag po zhig red zer nas bstod bsngags bsgrub pa'i ched du bsam pa sogs kyi kun slong gi thog nas blo sbyong bsgom mi rung gsungs pa red/ mgyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ ces pas su mgyogs kyi rno rtse bstan pa red/ dper na rta rgyugs pa'i skabs su nga mgyogs na bsam pa'i kun slong yod pa de bzhin ma byed gsungs pa red/ de'i don/ dper na chos pa mkhas pa dang nyams len byed mkhan gang 'dra zhig yin kyang / nga snyan grags che shos yin/ nga la mi yis mthong chen po byed/ nga yi rnyed bkur 'di che shos yin sogs bsam pa'i bsam blo gtong mi rung gsungs pa red/ lha bdud du ma phabs/ zhes lha zhes pa phan btags mkhan dang / bdud ces pa gnod pa bskyal mkhan red/ lha des gnod pa byas na lha bdud du phabs ces pa'i don du song ba red/ de yang blo sbyong bsgom pa de bdag 'dzin dang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po red/ des na blo sbyong bsgoms nas/ nga blo sbyong sgom mkhan yin/ chos pa zhe drag yag po yin/ nga'i blo sbyong de gzhan la med pa zhig yin bsam nas/ rang nyid nga rgyal dang / gzhan la khyad gsod byas pa yin na/ lha bdud du babs pa dang 'dra/ chos de chos ma yin pa la chags pa red/ de 'dra ma byed gsungs pa red/ de la dpal sprul rin po ches/ nga rgyal dge ba'i rgab 'dre zhes/ dge ba sna re byas na/ de yi rjes su nga rgyal re re 'phel gyi red/ des na gzab gzab byas nas nga rgyal mi skye ba zhig byed dgos gsungs pa red/ nga rgyal des skyon chen po byed kyi red/ bdag ni bran gyi tha ma ltar/ /las rnams kun la bkol par bya/ /zhes spyod 'jug las gsungs pa bzhin sems can su dang mnyam du 'grogs kyang / nga skyo shos yin/ dman shos yin/

bran gyi tha ma 'dra po yin bsam dgos gsungs pa red/ nga mkhas pa yin/ mtho po yin mi bsam/ nga rmongs shos yin bsam/ nga rgyal des nyon mongs pa mang po khrid yong gi yod tsang / nga skyo shos yin bsam ste bran gyi tha ma ltar du byed dgos gsungs pa red/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol/ ces dper na rang skyid pa'i thabs su gzhan la sdug po byung na bsam pa de ma byed zer ba red/ dper na mi zhig shi ba yin na de'i dngos chas ca lag 'ga' shas thob kyi red bsam pa'i 'du shes dang / yang mi skad grags can zhig yod na kho med pa chags na nga skad grags yong gi red bsam pa'i 'dun pa de 'dra byed mi rung gsungs pa red/ 'di yan chad blo sbyong gi dam tshig red/ dam tshig zer na spang bya de dag red/ bslab bya zhes pa nyams su len rgyu de dag la zer/ bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya ni/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes pa rnal 'byor thams cad ces gsang sngags kyi nyams len yin na kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba dang / ldang ba la sogs pa mang po yod red/ 'di la de 'dra mang po med/ rnal 'byor thams cad bdag gzhan brje ba gcig gis bya gsungs pa red/ dper na/ kha zas bzang po byung ba yin na/ kha zas bzang po zhe drag 'dug sems can thams cad kha zas ro brgya dang ldan par longs spyod par shog cig ces pa dang / kha zas de gzhan la gtong bar bsgom/ yang kha zas ngan pa zhig byung na yang / sems can rnams kyi kha zas sdug po yod pa thams cad nga'i 'dis go chod par shog de thams cad kyis 'di lta bu za mi dgos par shog cig ces pas len par bsgom/ 'di 'dra byas te rnal 'byor thams cad gcig tu byed dgos gsungs/ log gnon thams cad gcig gis bya/ zhes gegs sel zer ba ni chos nyams len byed pa'i gnas skabs su skyon mang po yong gi red/ de med par byed pa'i thabs la gegs sel zhes bya/

gegs sel thams cad blo sbyong gtong len gcig gis bya/ de ga 'dra yin snyam na/ dper na blo sbyong bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su/ lus la na tsha byung ba'i stobs kyis blo sbyong bsgom snying ma 'dod pa lta bu byung na/ de la len pa'i dmigs pa byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ sems can gyi khams la nga 'dra ba na tsha yod pa dang blo sbyong bsgom snying ma 'dod pa mang po yod pa red/ de dag thams cad kyi chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen ma lus pa thams cad ngas len thub par shog cig ces sems bskyed de gegs sel byed dgos/ de ltar byas na chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen de dag lam du byed kyi red/ de lta bu chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ma 'grigs pa mang po yod pa/ de thams cad kyi skabs su gong bzhin dmigs pa bya rgyu dang / sems can thams cad la chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par shog cig bsams te sgom thub pa byed dgos/ thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ zhes thog ma yar lang ba'i dus dang / tha ma mar nyal ba'i dus gnyis la bya ba gnyis yod gsungs pa red/ yar lang ba'i skabs su yang / da ngas de ring byang chub kyi sems yag po zhig bsgom dgos bsam nas sems bskyed na/ phan thogs chen po yod red gsungs/ mar nyal khar rang gis rang la zhu dag byas nas/ de ring ga 'dra byas 'dug byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'gal ba yag po bsgom 'dug dang mi 'dug brtag dpyad byas/ yag po red 'dug na dga' ba bsgom/ nyes pa byas 'dug na 'gyod sems skye/ slar mi byed pa'i dam bca' byas/ dge ba byas pa de la rjes su yi rangs dang / nyes pa byas yod na bshags pa byed dgos gsungs pa red/ gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ zhes gnyis po zhes pa/ skyid po dang sdug po/ 'byor pa dang rgud pa ga 'dra gcig byung na de gnyis la bzod thub pa zhig byed dgos gsungs pa red/ 'byor pa chen po dang longs spyod rgya chen po byung na de'i rkyen pas/

da nga'i gong na su yang med/ ngas gang byas na'ang 'grigs bsam pa byas nas mi la 'gras na skyid po bzod ma thub pa red/ yang longs spyod rgud po byung na/ de'i rkyen pas nga lta bu nyam chung gis chos ga la 'grub thub snyam pa'i zhum pa byas na chos kyi 'gal rkyen du song ba yin pas dbul po bzod ma thub pa chags pa red/ des na 'byor pa can zhig tu gyur na yang blo sbyong bsgom/ 'byor pa med mkhan sdug po byung na yang blo sbyong bsgom/ skyid po dang / 'byor pa ldan pa'i skabs su yang / da lan skyid po longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i skabs su ma byas na ga dus byed bsam pas blo sbyong bsgom/ sdug po zhig chags na yang da lan nga la chos bsgrub pa'i go skabs yag po byung / da lan mi byed na ga dus byed bsam pas blo sbyong bsgom nas 'byor rgud gnyis ka chos kyi mthun rkyen du 'gro ba zhig byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'byor pa chen po byung na nga rgyal mi byed par dman sa bzung / yi dwags bzhin du rgud na yang zhum pa mi byed/ blo sbyong gi mthun rkyen du 'gro ba zhig byed dgos kyi red/ tshang ma la de bzhin sbyar dgos/ dper na bstod pa dang smad pa gnyis ka bzod par byed/ snyan grags dang / snyan grags med pa gnyis ka bzod par byed/ rnyed bkur ldan pa dang rnyed bkur mi ldan pa gnyis ka bzod par byas nas chos kyi 'gal rkyen du ma song ba dang mthun rkyen du 'gro ba zhig byed dgos gsungs pa red/ gnyis po srog dang brdos la bsrung / zhes gnyis po zhes pa ni/ rang gis ga re khas blangs yod pa de'i bslab bya dang gcig blo sbyong gi dam tshig gong du bshad pa de gnyis rang gi srog dang brdos la ste srog dang brje nas bsrung dgos zhes pa red/ dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ zhes nyon mongs pa spong ba khag po yod zhes pa red/ khag po de dus tshod snga phyi bar gsum char la khag po yod pas nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs la bslab par bya dgos gsungs pa red/

de ga re yin snyam na/ dang po nyon mongs pa skye ba'i skabs su nyon mongs pa de dbang chen po song tsang gnyen po dran mi thub/ nga rang tshos sems la nyon mongs skyes na de rang bde ba'i rgyu yin bsam pa zhig yong gi red/ dper na mi gcig la khong khro lang nas/ tshig rtsub zhig lab pa yin na/ rang la bde ba thob kyi red bsam pa zhig yong gi yod na'ang / de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang 'gal ba red/ nyon mongs pa de sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung dang / sdug bsngal bden pa ni de'i 'bras bu yin gsungs pa red/ nga rang tshos nyon mongs pa la spyad pas bde ba thob yong bsam nas bsdad yod kyang / nga tshos chos dang 'gal ba'i las zhig la spyod kyi yod pas de'i gnyen po bsten dka' gsungs pa red/ bar du nyon mongs bzlog dka' ba/ zhes gnyen po tshar re gnyis tsam dran pa yin yang / nga tsho thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa'i dbang du shor ba yin tsang bzlog thub pa khag po red gsungs/ des na bar du bzlog dka' ba dang / mthar nyon mongs pa rgyun gcod par dka' ba/ zhes tha ma nyon mongs pa de bzlog pa yin na yang / nyon mongs de'i rgyun gcod par dka' bas/ nyon mongs spong ba la dka' las gsum yod gsungs pa red/ yin na yang / nyon mongs la gnyen po ma bsten thabs med pas/ de la gzab gzab byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ de la dang po nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po dran dgos/ gnyen po la yang mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ dper na spyod 'jug gi rtsa ba blo la yod na phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ nga rgyal gyi gnyen po dang / zhe sdang gi gnyen po kha thug kha thug la dgos pa de tsho spyod 'jug gi nang du gsungs yod pa red/ zhe sdang gi rigs mang po yod pa dang / zhe sdang skye ba'i sems de tsho 'gog thabs mang po yod pas/ nga tshos de tsho yang yang dran thub pa byed dgos/ nyon mongs pa de tsho tshar gcig bzlog thub pa byung na/

da phyin chad ngas nyon mongs pa mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' byed dgos/ rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang/ /zhes theg pa chen po'i chos nyams su len pa la mthun rkyen mang po yod dgos kyang / de rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo gsum po de len thub pa byed dgos/ dang po bla ma yag po zhig bsten dgos/ bla ma yag po zhig bsten pa de rgyu gcig red/ de'i steng du dad pa yag po zhig yod dgos/ de rgyu gnyis pa red/ zas nor dang khang pa la sogs pa chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yang 'dzoms dgos/ de rgyu gsum pa red/ gang ltar chos bsgrub pa la de gsum 'dzoms thabs byed dgos kyi red/ de gsum 'dzoms na dga' ba bsgom/ sems can gzhan rnams la yang de lta bu 'dzoms par shog ces dang / gzhan la gtong bar bsgom pa bcas mthun rkyen gsum 'dzoms thabs byed pa la nges par du 'bad brtson byed dgos/ nyams pa med pa rnam gsum sgoms/ /zhes bla ma la dad pa nyams rgyu med pa dper na/ jo bo rje la bod mi zhig gis zhus pa/ bod la sgom rgyag mkhan mang po zhig 'dug kyang / nyams rtogs kyi yon tan skye mkhan mi 'dug de ga re byung ba red zhus pas/ jo bos/ khyod bden/ bod pa la yon tan skye gi ma red/ yon tan tshang ma bla ma la bsten nas skye dgos pas/ bod pas bla ma la sangs rgyas phar bzhag dad pa yag po zhig mi 'dug pas yon tan 'byung gi ma red/ bla ma bzang ngan ga 'dra zhig yin yang dbye 'byed ma byas par sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i dad pa byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ rgya gar gyi grub thob de tshos phyi'i mdzad spyod la/ spyod pa chab be chob be mang po bstan na yang / dad pa byed mkhan de tsho grol ba red/ dad pa mi byed mkhan de tsho ma grol ba red gsungs pa red/ de tsho tshig nus pa chen po red/ dad pa byed dang mi byed so so la rag las pa red/ rdo ring pa'i gsung las/

'brog mi lo tsā ba'i gsung sgros zhig la/ bla ma de mnar med la skye mkhan zhig yin kyang / bla ma sangs rgyas yin bsam pa'i dad pa bzhag pa yin na rang la sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs 'jug gi red/ de gang yin zhe na/ chos nyid la khyad par med pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs yod pa red gsungs/ des na bla ma la dad pa nyams pa med pa zhig nges par du dgos/ blo sbyong la spro ba nyams pa med pa/ zhes pa ni chos kyi snying po blo sbyong 'di bsgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa zhig dgos gsungs pa red/ rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam tshig nyams pa med pa zhig kyang dgos gsungs pa red/ bod la blo sbyong de chos yag po zhig yina'ang sa ma thob bar du bsgom rgyu yod ma red gsung mkhan 'ga' shas byung ba red/ de la chos rje sa paṇa gyis dgag pa mang po mdzad yod/ yang gcig la bdag gzhan brje zhes pa'i don de/ bdag gces 'dzin brje zhes pa'i don yin pa red/ nga rang gces par 'dzin pa dang sems can gzhan yal bar dor ba brje zhes pa'i don las bde sdug dang dge sdig brje ba'i don ma red/ ga re yin zer na/ rang dang gzhan gyi bde sdug dang dge sdig rnams brje thub yag yong ma red ces gsung mkhan zhig byung ba red/ de la kun mkhyen gyis sdom gsum kha skong nang du rgyas bshad mang po mdzad yod pa red/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing/ /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces pas de'i don gsal por bstan yod/ nga rang tshos brtag na yang brje rgyu gcig nges par du yod dgos kyi yod pa red/ spyod 'jug las/ gzhan gyi grags pa lhag brjod nas/ /rang gi grags pa zil gyis mnon/ /zhes pa de bde sdug brje ba'i don red/ mi la g.yog po mi bskul ba dang / rang gis mi yi g.yog po byed pa de yang brje ba'i don red/ rang gi nyes pa de gzhan gyi yin mi zer ba dang /

gzhan gyi nyes pa de rang gi yin zer ba de yang brje ba'i don red/ tshang ma brje thub yag med kyang brje tshul mang po gsungs yod/ dper na/ spyod 'jug las/ mdor na bdag gi don gyi phyir/ /khyod kyis gzhan la gnod byas gang / /gnod de sems can don gyi phyir/ /bdag nyid la ni 'bab par gyis/ /zhes pa de bdag gzhan brje ba'i don ngo ma de red/ 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /zhes pa ni lus ngag yid gsum dge ba gsum dang mi 'bral bar gyis zhes pa'i don yin/ yul la phyogs med dag tu bsgom/ zhes pa ni blo sbyong bsgom pa'i yul de phyogs ris med par bsgom dgos zhes pa red/ dper na rang gi ma lta bu la bsgom pa dang gzhan la ma bsgom pa/ yang sems can rnams la bsgom pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten de tsho la mi bsgom pa de lta bu ma yin pa/ snod dang bcud/ sems can dang sems can ma yin pa dbye ba med par thams cad cha snyoms su bsgom dgos zhes pa red/ khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces/ zhes khyab zhes pa yul thams cad la bsgom dgos kyi red zhes pa'i don red/ gting 'byongs zhes pa ni/ kha tsam ma yin pa sems kyi gting nas bsgom dgos kyi red gsungs pa dang / kun la gces zhes pa ni dus rtag tu bsgom dgos zhes pa red/ bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes pa ni zur du bkol ba rnams la dmigs bsal byas nas bsgom dgos zhes pa red/ ga re yin zer na/ sems can la brten nas dge ba dang sdig pa gang bsags pa de'i 'bras bu ngan song dang thar pa de dag phal cher sems can kun tu 'grogs pa rnams la brten dgos kyi yod red/ des na de rnams la gzab gzab byas nas bsgom dgos kyi red gsungs/ bkol ba de la blo sbyong 'grel chen rnams kyi nang du bkol ba lnga yod gsungs 'dug /rang la bka' drin chen po rnams la gzab gzab byas nas bsgom dgos pa/ rang la rtag par 'grogs pa de rnams la dmigs bsal byas nas bsgom dgos pa yin/

'ga' zhig gis bla ma 'di tshos sems can gnad chen po yin gsung rgyu de rgyang ring po zhig la yod pa yin tsang zer gyi red/ mdun na yod pa de tsho la rogs pa rtsa ba nas byed kyi mi 'dug zer bla ma la skur 'debs byed pa yang yod/ des na rang gi nye 'khris su yod pa de tsho la dmigs bsal byas nas bsgom pa/ rang la 'gran zla byed mkhan de tsho la bsgom pa/ rang gis ji ltar yag po byas kyang rang la rtsa ba nas mi dga' mkhan de rnams la bsgom pa/ rang la las kyi dbang gis ga re byas kyang gtan nas mi dga' mkhan de rnams la bsgom pa de tsho la bkol ba lnga zhes pa red/ rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya/ zhes pa dper na cho ga gzhan dag rnams ga 'dra zhig yin kyang de'i skabs su rdzas cha gzhan gtor ma la sogs mang po zhig 'dus dgos kyi yod pa red/ blo sbyong 'di la de ltar ma yin pa rkyen bzang po dang ngan pa la sogs ga re byung ba des blo sbyong ba'i rkyen byed pa red/ de las gzhan gang la yang ltos mi dgos gsungs pa red/ da res gtso bo nyams su len/ zhes pa dge ba bsgrub rgyu de gtso bo byed dgos kyi red/ thob par dka' ba mi lus 'di thob pa'i dus da res yin zhes pa red/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba dag ni ma bsgrub cing / /sdig pa dag ni nyer bsags pas/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di/ spyir 'bras bu ga re 'byung ba de/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten dgos/ mtho ris ni rgyu dge ba'i 'bras bu yin pas/ dge ba gsog mkhan nyung ba'i stabs kyis mtho ris thob par dka' ba yin gsungs pa red/ des na da res dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ dam pa'i chos thos/ chos thos pa de shes pa'i skabs su yag po zhig nyams len byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ gtso bo zhes gnad che shos de nyams su len dgos kyi red gsungs/

chos dang 'jig rten gnyis chos gnad che ba dang / chos de la yang theg pa che chung gnyis las theg pa chen po'i chos dang / de la yang mang po yod pa rnams las blo sbyong de gnad che shos byed dgos/ de yang bshad pa dang sgrub pa gnyis yod pa las sgrub pa gnad che shos bya rgyu gal che gsungs pa red/ go log mi bya/ zhes go log drug yod pa red/ bzod pa go log ni/ chos kyi don du dka' ba spyad mi thub pa/ 'jig rten pa'i bya ba mi dge ba'i las dka' ba la bzod pa de bzod pa go log /'dun pa go log ni/ sdig pa bshags pa dang bsod nams gsog pa la 'dun pa mi bya zhing tshe 'dir skyid po zhig byung na bsam pa de 'dun pa go log /ro myong go log ni/ thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan gyi ro mi myong zhing / 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi ro myong ba de la ro myong go log /snying rje go log ni/ sdig pa byed mkhan la snying rje byed dgos pas de ma byas shing / dge ba bsgrub par ngal dub byung ba de la snying rje byas pa snying rje go log /gnyer sems go log ni/ rang la dbang cha yod pa'i mi de tsho chos bsgrub pa'i gnyer sems dgos pa de ma byas nas tshe 'di'i don bsgrub pa la gnyer sems byas pa la gnyer sems go log /rjes su yi rangs go log ni/ gzhan skyid pa byung na rjes su yi rangs bya dgos pa dang / sdug po byung na de la rjes su yi rangs byed rgyu med na'ang / sdug po byung ba de la dga' ba bsgom/ skyid po byung na mi dga' ba byed pa de la rjes su yi rangs go log zer/ des na go log drug po de dag spangs nas/ go ma log pa drug po de byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ res 'jog mi bya/ zhes mtshams mtshams su blo sbyong 'di gnad chen po zhig yin par 'dra bsam nas tshab bi tshub bir bsgom/ mtshams mtshams 'di sa chod zhe drag yod kyi ma red/ 'di las gzhan pa zhig bsgom dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas/

blo sbyong gi nyams len res 'ga' byed/ res 'ga' mi byed pa spang nas dus rtag tu rtse gcig tu bsgom dgos gsungs pa red/ dol chod du sbyongs/ zhes the tshom chod pa'i don yin/ the tshom ma byas par bsgom dgos kyi red gsungs/ ga re yin snyam na/ chos 'di gnad che chung ga 'dra yin snyam pa'i the tshom dang / ngas byed thub dang mi thub snyam pa'i the tshom dang / da lta byed dgos kyi yin nam/ rjes ma byed dgos snyam pa'i the tshom sogs/ the tshom thams cad med par byas te sems thag bcad nas nyams len byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyis thar bar bya/ zhes rtog dpyod gnyis kyis sems sbyong zhes pa ni/ rtsing po zhig byed kyi 'dug gam/ zhib cha byas nas nyams su len gyi 'dug brtag dpyad gtong dgos/ brtag dpyad gnyis kyi sgo nas rang gi rgyud la nyon mongs ga re 'dug zhib cha byas nas rang gi rgyud de nyon mongs pa bdag 'dzin las thar bar bya ba'i thabs byed dgos gsungs pa red/ yus ma sgoms/ zhes yus zhes pa bka' drin bskyangs pa ma bsgoms gsungs pa red/ 'di gnad chen po red/ dper na mi gzhan la rogs pa mang po byas pa yin na'ang / ngas de byas yod bsam pas bka' drin bsgom mi rung gsungs pa red/ nga drin chen po yin bsam pa de rtsa ba nas bsam rgyu yod pa ma red gsungs/ der ma zad yus ma bsgom zhes pa gzhan yang / nga mkhas pa yin/ nga btsun pa yin/ nga mi chen po yin/ stobs chen po yin bsam pa rtsa ba nas dran mi rung / de ltar dran pa ni so so'i rang don tsam red/ ma zad de ltar dran na mis rang nyid la bstod pas nga rgyal dang khengs dregs skye/ gzhan la brnyas bcos dang dma' 'bebs byed pas na/ yus byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med pas yus ma bsgom gsungs pa red/ ko long ma bsdams/ zhes pa ni sems chung dang / sems ma bde ba'i don dang / yang na 'khrugs long gi don red/

blo kha mi bab pa/ dper na gzhan gyis lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur bstan pa la blor ma babs pas/ tha na ca lag bzhag stangs tshun chad ma 'grigs pa byung tshe rnam 'gyur ma ston gsungs pa red/ yud tsam mi bya/ zhes spyod pa ngan pa dang mi brtan pa/ grogs po dang gzhan su rung la 'khrugs pa rgyag chog chog de 'dra byed rgyu med gsungs pa red/ dper na/ da lta yag po zhig yod na'ang / lam seng 'gyur ldog chen po 'gro ba de 'dra ma yin pa yag po dang brtan po byed dgos/ grogs po'i sems la gzan po dang / grogs po dang 'grogs khag po de 'dra byed rgyu yod ma red gsungs pa red/ 'or che ma 'dod/ ces pa ni rang gi chos kyi bya ba byas pa'am/ las bzang po brtsams pa/ gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa sogs dge ba'i las bsags pa sogs la/ gzhan gyis yag po byung 'dug bkrin che zhes tshig gi gtang rag 'byung ba la re ba mi byed pa de yin/ de ltar gcig las gcig gnad 'gag che ba'i bslab bya de tsho ni blo sbyong gi nyams len mi nyams shing gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs khyad par can zhig yin/ mdor na jo bo rjes/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis po mnyam brje gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par sbyangs nas/ sems 'byongs pa'i gdeng thob pa zhig bya dgos ces gdams pa ltar 'bad par rigs so/ snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'dis/ byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin/ ces pa ni dus dang / sems can/ tshe dang / nyon mongs dang / lta ba snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i nyer len la brten/ bde ba'i mthun rkyen nyung zhing / 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa mang ba 'di dag sems can thams can la mthar thug gi bde ba ster ba'i byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur thub pa zhig bya dgos zhes pa'i don yin/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di/ /gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin/ ces pas 'di lta bu 'gal rkyen nyon mongs pa thams cad mthun rkyen byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di/
